name: TaxRate
description: A TaxRate object represents a rate applied to calculate tax liability (created via the TaxService entity).

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required for update. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time; incremented on each modification.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: User recognizable name for the tax rate.

fields.name: AgencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the tax agency associated with this object.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The ID of the referenced tax agency object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: An identifying display name for the referenced object.

fields.name: SpecialTaxType
fields.description: Special tax type to handle zero rate taxes. Used with VAT registered businesses who receive goods/services (acquisitions) from other EU countries, to calculate VAT due but not paid on these acquisitions.

fields.name: EffectiveTaxRate
fields.description: List of EffectiveTaxRate. An EffectiveTaxRate is used to know which taxrate is applicable on any date.

fields.name: DisplayType
fields.description: TaxRate DisplayType enum which acts as display config.

fields.name: TaxReturnLineRef
fields.description: Reference to the tax return line associated with this object.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The ID of the referenced tax return line object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: An identifying display name for the referenced object.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: If true, this object is currently enabled for use by QuickBooks.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created in the source domain.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated in the source domain.

fields.name: OriginalTaxRate
fields.description: ID of the original tax rate from which the new tax rate is derived. Helps to understand the relationship between corresponding tax rate entities.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: User entered description for the tax rate.
